14. Behavior Change Counseling is psychological counseling provided to male perpetrators of domestic violence to help stop violence and become a person who can respect their partner, so they can establish a better relationship with their partner and children.

16. 17. Forum for Handling Victims of Violence against Women and Children abbreviated as FPK2PA is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is networked and established at the regency and sub-district levels.
18. Safe House is a shelter for victims, during the assistance process, for the safety and comfort of victims from threats and danger from perpetrators.
19. Standard Operating Procedure hereinafter abbreviated as SOP is standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaint/identification, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, legal services, up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.
20. Family is the smallest unit in society consisting of husband and wife, or husband-wife and their children, or father and children, or mother and children, or blood relatives in a straight line upward or downward up to the third degree.

22. Gender Mainstreaming in the Region is a strategy built to integrate gender into an integral dimension of planning, formulation, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of policies, programs, and development activities in the region.
23. Gender is a concept that refers to the differentiation of roles, functions, and responsibilities of men and women that occur as a result of and can be changed by the social and cultural conditions of society.
24. Gender Equality is equality of conditions for men and women to obtain opportunities and their rights as human beings so they are able to play a role and participate in political, economic, socio-cultural activities, national defense and security, and equality in enjoying the results of development.
25. Gender Justice is a process to be fair to men and women.
26. Disaggregated data is data disaggregated by sex and status and conditions of women and men in all fields of development including health, education, economy and employment, politics and decision-making, law and socio-culture and violence.
27. Gender Responsive Planning and Budgeting is a series of approaches to integrate gender perspectives in the planning and budgeting process, gender responsive planning is planning to achieve gender equality and justice, which is carried out through integrating experiences, aspirations, needs, potentials, and problem solving of women and men.

The retrieved candidates included this exact clause (in [3.1-31] and also referenced in the [2.3] candidate set via Article 25), so a judge could have answered Yes for an indicator about data collection/information systems (at least at the level of mandated reporting/collection). The judge was overly strict by requiring a ‘dedicated system’ beyond mandated collection and reporting.

VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE
I. GENERAL
Acts of violence against women and children constitute violations of human rights, therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature and disposition without discrimination.
In order to prevent and overcome violence against women and children in Gunungkidul Regency so that they are protected from violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and honor, it is necessary to provide protection for women and children victims of violence in the form of regional regulations.
Thus far, laws and regulations governing the protection of women and children victims of violence have not yet regulated protection measures at the Regional level, therefore institutional support and regulations are needed that can guarantee their implementation.
This Regional Regulation regulates protection measures for victims, particularly in terms of prevention, services and empowerment of women and children victims of violence in Gunungkidul Regency.

16. 19. Standard Operating Procedure hereinafter abbreviated as SOP is standard steps that must be taken in protecting victims starting from complaint/identification, health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, legal services, up to repatriation and social reintegration of witnesses and/or victims.

INTEGRATED SERVICE CENTER
Article 12
(1) PPT is established by the Regional Government, Vertical Agencies in the Region, or community institutions.
(2) The Regional Government establishes the Networked P2TP2A as an integrated service center by Regent's Decree.
(3) The Networked P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (2) is a functional work unit that has the duties and functions of providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
(4) In carrying out the duties as referred to in paragraph (3), the Networked P2TP2A may provide services and temporary protection in the form of a safe house.
(5) In the event that the Networked P2TP2A does not have a safe house (shelter) as referred to in paragraph (4), then victims of violence are referred to a PPT that has a safe house.

Article 11
Other violence as referred to in Article 5 letter f is caused by:
a. threat of violence includes any unlawful act in the form of speech, writing, images, symbols, or body movements, whether with or without using means that cause fear or restrict a person's fundamental freedom; and
b. coercion, includes a situation where a person/victim is ordered to do something in such a way that the person does something that is contrary to their own will.

Second Part
Empowerment Efforts for Child Victims of Violence. Article 33 (1) The Regional Government provides empowerment for child victims of violence.
(2) Empowerment as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented by the Networked P2TP2A and may cooperate with all parties.

Article 10
Exploitation as referred to in Article 5 letter (e) is caused by:
a. acts that exploit economically or sexually with the intention of benefiting oneself or others;
b. acts with or without the consent of the victim which include but are not limited to prostitution, forced labor or services, slavery or similar practices, oppression, extortion, exploitation of physical, sexual, reproductive organs, or unlawfully removing or transplanting organs and/or body tissues or exploiting the labor or ability of a person by other parties to obtain benefits both material and immaterial; and/or
c. all forms of exploitation of sexual organs or other body organs of the victim to obtain benefits, including but not limited to all activities of prostitution or sexual abuse

Article 4
The scope of protection for Victims includes prevention efforts, services to victims of violence, rehabilitation, and empowerment of victims of violence in the Region.

5.8.rationale: The original text explicitly includes private organizations in the definition of community institutions: Penjelasan Pasal 12 ayat (1) lists "organisasi swasta" (private organizations) among the types of lembaga masyarakat. Since Pasal 12(1) allows PPT to be established by community institutions, the regulation contemplates private-sector organizational involvement in service provision structures. The retrieved candidates for 5.8 did not surface this Penjelasan clause; they only showed general cooperation language. Therefore the main issue is retrieval not surfacing the explicit ‘organisasi swasta’ evidence; with only the shown passages, the judge’s No is understandable.
